item.title: PlannetExpress - PG Practice
item.description: Summary: This is a cool vulnerable machine that illustrates PHP-FPM FastCGI vulnerability well. This PHP-FPM FastCGI vulnerability can be utilized to gain the initial foothold. And misconfigured SUID binary was used to escalate privileges.
